About - MILLER BOYS | Home | Services | About | RATES | Contact | THE mechanic | Josh | Born out of necessity, Josh learned to work on his own vehicles as a young man. It quickly grew into a hobby that he greatly enjoyed. After serving in the US Army, Josh attended Universal Technical Institute to receive formal automotive training. He excelled in his course work. While at UTI, Josh completed extra training to become a Certified Ford Technician. Following graduation from the Automotive Mechanics Technology Program at UTI, he went on to complete Cummins Power South University where he became a Certified Cummins Technician. He went to work for Cummins doing Coach Care, solely working on RV engines and generators. Since then, he has been working servicing and repairing diesel engines of all kinds. He is excited to be able to offer those services now in a mobile capacity to the RV community. | Outside of work, Josh enjoys spending time with his family. His two teenaged sons are interested in mechanics and construction, working with Josh on projects every chance they get. His little "Baby Love" enjoys being silly with dada, long walks, and playing at the park.
